council: Council of the Isles of Scilly
current_evidence: The council's 'Local Validation Checklists for Planning Applications' page says Members adopted an updated Local Validation Checklist in November 2025 and links both Grokbot's URL ('here') and the /document/planning/ copy ('Local Validation Checklist + Guidance | November 2025'); the document cover reads 'Adopted | 18/11/2025'.

issues.detail: Many rows come from superseded 2021 checklists, not the November 2025 list. Sources include 'planning-apps/Householder Checklist 01-2021_5.pdf', 'planning-apps/Full Application Checklist.pdf' and 'planning-apps/Listed Building Consent Checklist 01-2021.pdf'. All 21 of the Householder rows except Structural Survey cite the 2021 householder checklist, and many Full/LBC rows cite the old Full checklist. Their triggers quote 'NPPF 2019' paragraphs and old thresholds, e.g. Householder 'no more than 30% above' NDSS and Full 'no more than 10% above'.
issues.evidence: Planning page links only the '(November 2025)' checklists under /sites/default/files/document/planning/; app_type_rows sources .../planning-apps/...01-2021...

issues.detail: Listed building consent has 36 rows, mostly copied from the old Full and Householder checklists: Affordable Housing Statement, Agricultural Justification, Air Quality, Contaminated Land, Environmental Statement, Landscaping, Noise, Statement of Community Involvement, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Ventilation/Extraction, Viability, Housing mix/NDSS, Water efficiency, Drainage/SuDS, Flood Risk, HRA, Ecology, Archaeology, Arboricultural. The November 2025 LBC checklist asks only for: application form, location plan, site plan, 1:20 detailed drawings, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement/HIA, and Structural Survey (LR, where demolition, rebuilding or significant repairs are proposed).
issues.evidence: LVC Nov 2025, Listed Building Consent checklist items 1-7: '7a. Structural Survey (LR): Application proposes demolition of a listed building, or rebuilding or significant repairs'

issues.detail: 'Health Impact Assessment' is listed under Listed building consent, but its trigger text is 'Heritage Statement / Impact Assessment (HIA)'. Grokbot read 'HIA' (Heritage Impact Assessment) as Health Impact Assessment. The 2025 list has no Health Impact Assessment requirement.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'Heritage Statement / Impact Assessment (HIA) [Guidance] National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) Requirement...'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the November 2025 list that Grokbot missed: Infrastructure Impact Assessment (Full: significant increase in infrastructure use; new dwellings or conversions; new buildings or conversions needing new drainage or water connections); Specific Local Need application (Full: homes intended to meet a Specific Local Need); Statement of Existing and Proposed Internal Floorspace (Householder and Full: new dwellings, extensions, conversions, replacement dwellings), which Grokbot replaced with 2021 NDSS '+30%/+10%' wording; Scheme of Sustainable Design Measures (Householder and Full: new buildings, conversions, domestic extensions), which appears only as a garbled 'Energy/Sustainability Statement' under Full; Planning Statement (LR for Householder unless the content is in the DAS/Heritage Statement), which is absent from the Householder rows.
issues.evidence: LVC Nov 2025 Full section LRs: 'Infrastructure Impact Assessment', 'Specific Local Need application'; Householder LRs: 'Planning Statement', 'Scheme of Sustainable Design Measures', 'Statement of Existing and Proposed Internal Floorspace'
issues.grok_comment: Most of the missed items are real gaps. But the Sustainable Design Measures requirement is partly captured: the "Water efficiency / water usage statement" rows (Householder, Full, LBC) quote its description ("reduce energy and water consumption, including water harvesting measures"). It is not only a garbled Full-planning Energy row.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Sustainable Design Measures is partly captured under the water efficiency rows. The other missed items stand.

issues.detail: Advertisement consent, Lawful development cert and Discharge of conditions show '(none)', and Works to trees has only a mislabelled row. The council publishes November 2025 checklists for each of these, which Grokbot did not read: Advertisement Consent, Certificate of Lawful Use (Existing or Proposed), Discharge of Condition and Tree Works.
issues.evidence: Planning page attachments: 'Advertisement Consent Checklist', 'Certificate of Lawful Use (Existing or Proposed) Checklist', 'Discharge of Condition Checklist', 'Tree Works Checklist' (all November 2025)

issues.detail: Some Householder rows are not in the 2025 Householder section and come from the 2021 checklist: Archaeological Assessment (2025: Full only, for trenching/foundations near known archaeology, all new dwellings, new employment buildings) and Shadow HRA (2025: Full only). Tab_items also file Shadow HRA and EIA screening under 'all application types'. Photos/Photomontages and Street scene apply only to Full & Advertisement Consent, but are filed under Full planning generally.
issues.evidence: LVC Nov 2025: Householder LRs = Planning Statement, SWMP, Sustainable Design Measures, Internal Floorspace, Ecology/Bat, External Illumination, FRA, Light Assessment, Tree Survey; 'Full + Advertisement Consent (additional) ... Photos and photomontages (existing premises, street scene, proposed sign): LR'

issues.detail: Many triggers are fragments or text from neighbouring items. Examples: Energy/Sustainability Statement and Structural Survey (Full) both read 'Isles of Scilly Sustainable Energy Strategy Page 17 of 59 Structural Survey...'; Viability 'Dark Skies Handbook Financial Viability Statement...'; Noise 'Right of Light Fact Sheets Noise Assessment...'; Transport 'Flood repairable house guidance Travel Plan...'; Drainage 'information on SUDS.'; EIA 'development plan, EIA development applications.'; Photographs (Householder/LBC) 'maps, aerial photographs, archaeological journals and databases' (archaeology guidance); 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Householder, Full, LBC and Works to trees carries arboricultural method statement text. The Flood Risk excerpt is cut off before the local trigger (land below 5m datum; 1ha+ in FZ1; all new development in FZ2/3).
issues.evidence: LVC Nov 2025 FRA trigger: 'sites with potential flood risk, including land below 5m datum; 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1; all new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3'

issues.detail: The External Illumination Statement (a dark-skies LR for householder, full, LBC and tree works with outdoor lighting) is mapped to the category 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' under Householder and LBC. That mislabels it as an advertisement requirement.
issues.evidence: Householder trigger excerpt: '5 External Illumination Statement ... Policy Justification NPPF 2019: Paragraph 180 Local Plan Policy: 2015-2030: Policy OE1, OE4'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are contact details, process text or fragments rather than requirements: 'Applications can also be submitted via email to planning@scilly.gov.uk, with the application fee settled over the phone ... 0300 1234 105'; 'As with an email submission, the application fee should be settled over the phone...'; 'Using the Checklist This document has been designed for both electronic and hard copy use.'; 'Our Checklist includes both local and national validation requirements ... one-stop-shop.'; 'Metric Scale Plans and Drawings [Guidance] NR ☐ 5.' and '... NR ☐ 3.'; 'Drawings not to a recognised metric scale.' (a reason for invalidity, not a requirement).
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Submission rules', 'Local forms / checklists', 'Drawing / document standards'

issues.detail: Tab_items repeat the same requirement: two near-identical HRA trigger rows ('adverse likely significant effect on nearby European Sites...' and 'adverse effect on nearby sites...'), and 'The inclusion of a linear scale bar is recommended' twice. Several app-type rows reuse one excerpt for different requirements, e.g. Energy/Sustainability and Structural Survey under Full planning.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Policy-driven requirements' rows 1 and 4; 'Drawing / document standards' rows 8 and 10

issues.detail: The List date is recorded as 2025-11-01, but the document gives the exact adoption date of 18 November 2025, and Grokbot's own Date basis says 'adopted on 18th November 2025'.
'Planning page' is the council homepage (https://www.scilly.gov.uk), not the planning validation page that links the checklists.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current November 2025 Local Validation Checklist (adopted 18/11/2025), though robots.txt blocks automated fetching from that path. Much of the extraction is drawn from superseded 2021 checklists: LBC rows are mostly Full-planning requirements, 'HIA' was misread as Health Impact Assessment, and new 2025 local requirements and separate checklists (advert, LDC, discharge, tree works) were missed.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
